findings.remediation: The production-runner seal now includes exact Docker container Id and Created identity plus image, entrypoint, command, network, labels, hashed environment and bounded privilege/mount/capability/device/PID/rootfs/security configuration. Quiesce, start and retirement compare this seal; a dynamic exact-config replacement with a different Id is rejected.

Every terminal state write now embeds a deterministic receipt binding primitive, request digest, pre-state digest, terminal result and terminal post-state digest. Every relevant entry reconciles the receipt: exactly one matching record passes, none appends exactly once through the audit core, and duplicates/drift fail closed. A dynamic test simulates the crash after durable terminal state and proves two resumptions leave one record.
